concept.headline: See what a spine check costs
concept.primary_text: First visit? Grab the $49 new-patient exam and consultation. It’s a straightforward way to see if chiropractic fits your routine, with transparent pricing and no surprises. Same-day appointments are often available for new patients.
concept.description: Includes a digital posture scan. Book your $49 exam today.
concept.rationale: This ad targets value-conscious adults by front-loading the specific price point ($49) to reduce perceived risk. The visual uses a calm, clinical still life to reinforce professionalism and transparency, avoiding generic stock imagery. The copy focuses on the 'learning' aspect of the first visit, aligning with the brief's request to invite users to learn about the consultation.

visual.direction: A top-down view of a clean, light-colored oak desk surface. In the center, a simple, unbranded digital tablet displays a subtle, abstract line-art representation of a spine alignment (no text on screen). To the left, a pair of folded, neutral-toned reading glasses rests on a small stack of three crisp, white notepads. Soft, natural light enters from the top left, casting gentle, long shadows. The background is a plain, warm beige wall. The lower third of the image is a clean, empty space with a soft gradient shadow to allow for text overlay. No people, no logos, no medical instruments.

sourceQuotes: Digital posture scan included on your first visit

concept.headline: Stop guessing what hurts.
concept.primary_text: If your back aches after a long day at a desk or weekend game, you need a real answer, not a guess. Our board-certified chiropractors offer a $49 new-patient exam to pinpoint the source of your discomfort. No pressure, just clear insights and a plan for relief. Book your same-day appointment today.
concept.description: See what’s causing your pain with our $49 new-patient exam.
concept.rationale: This ad targets adults in Austin with chronic desk-job or weekend-athlete pain who hesitate to commit to a full treatment plan. By leading with the frustration of uncertainty ('stop guessing') and anchoring the solution in the specific, low-risk $49 exam, it reduces the barrier to entry. The visual of a calm, professional consultation room reinforces the promise of clear, non-pushy care, aligning the message with the warm, plain-spoken tone requested.

visual.direction: A medium shot of a bright, clean chiropractic consultation room in Austin. Focus on a chiropractor in business casual attire leaning slightly forward, speaking attentively to a patient who is seated comfortably on an exam table, looking relaxed and listening. The background is softly blurred, showing neutral beige walls and natural light from a window. The mood is welcoming, professional, and calm. No text or logos in the image. The focal point is the interaction between the two individuals, positioned slightly to the right to leave space on the left for text.

sourceQuotes: Board-certified chiropractors with 15+ years combined experience

concept.headline: Weekend soreness, Monday ready.
concept.primary_text: If weekend activity leaves you stiff for work, a clear plan helps. Cedar Ridge offers a $49 new-patient exam and consultation. Our board-certified chiropractors assess your spine and posture in Austin, Round Rock, or Cedar Park. Same-day appointments are available for new patients. See what a first visit involves.
concept.description: Book your $49 exam in Austin, Round Rock, or Cedar Park.
concept.rationale: This ad targets the friction between active weekends and desk-job stiffness. By leading with the specific physical tension of being 'sore' on Monday, it resonates with the 30-60 age group and weekend athletes. The visual focuses on the release of tension rather than a clinical setting, making the $49 exam feel like an accessible solution to a recurring problem. The copy strictly adheres to supplied facts regarding price, locations, and staff credentials without promising specific outcomes.

concept.headline: Desk work doesn't have to hurt
concept.primary_text: If long hours at a computer leave you stiff or sore, it’s time to see what’s going on with your spine. Cedar Ridge Chiropractic in Austin offers a $49 new-patient exam and consultation. We take time to listen and check out your alignment. See if we’re a good fit for your back care.
concept.description: New patients get a $49 exam and consultation at our Austin clinic.
concept.rationale: This ad targets the primary pain point of desk-bound adults: chronic stiffness. By leading with the specific cause (desk work) and the specific solution (a low-cost initial exam), it lowers the barrier to entry. The visual avoids generic medical tropes, focusing instead on the relief of standing and stretching, which directly answers the 'relief' aspect of the brief. The tone is professional but approachable, emphasizing the consultation over aggressive treatment promises.
